instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. stem: A 58-year-old client with untreated non-small cell lung cancer and a known right mediastinal mass has worsening facial and periorbital edema, neck circumference increased from 44 cm to 47 cm, more prominent chest-wall venous collaterals, bilateral upper-extremity pitting edema, SpO2 90% on 2 L nasal cannula, short-phrase speech, and new faint inspiratory stridor over the trachea.
